meta.name: High Priestess
meta.description:
Revolves around Swathi Reddy, a tarot card reader and psychic, who deals with peculiar cases and clients that make her experience supernatural powers around her.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Maya
videos.overview: Swati finds herself entangled in a missing person’s case. More information about her character and capabilities are revealed. What evil does the darkness hold? Will light win?

videos.title: Ruby
videos.overview: Swati is surprised to meet her new client Vikram, who also happens to be her college friend. Swati narrates the story of Ruby, an airhostess, who starts losing her charm after marriage. How extreme can Ruby go to attain eternal beauty?

videos.title: Vanity
videos.overview: Ruby has unleashed an ancient demon to attain eternal beauty. She comes to Swati begging for help. Swati takes up the fight against the spirit and it just might lead to an exorcism. You never know.

As Vikram and Swati continue speaking and reminiscing upon their memories, Swati tells Vikram about her first case. She narrates how Siddharth was haunted by a number and how she used something very interesting to try and solve his problem.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: Swati gets emotional as Vikram talks about their short-lived relationship. As Swati reaches out for something, a coconut pops out of her cupboard and Vikram gets curious to know about the coconut. Swati narrates a lawyer’s story which initially seems funny but takes a terrifying twist.

videos.title: Innocence
videos.overview: The episode is a tale about how an urban/liberal family – Ram, Vaishnavi, and their kid Abhinav move into a house which has a tinge of paranormal history and the events drag Swati into this ordeal.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: What happens when two guys and a girl are involved? Swati and Vikram grow closer when Krishna shows up with a problem at Swati’s door. A new story is narrated which is about Radhika, Krishna, Varun, and their friendship.

videos.title: Into the Light
videos.overview: Krishna continues to see Radhika’s spirit and meets Swati to find the answers. Swati helps Krishna and also gets Vikram to openly discuss about their relationship.
